authority_boundary.interpretation: The project owner may constrain the active data source and authorize non-model engineering. This record is not independent approval for method selection, fitting, calibration, validation or promotion.

active_data_source.runtime_location_policy: Injected by CLI or configuration; no machine-specific path is part of the AstroGraph core contract.
active_data_source.environment_policy: Sat-Agent and AstroGraph retain independent interpreters and communicate only through versioned file or API contracts.

s0_goal: Inventory and contract-test component, subsystem and whole-spacecraft evidence within the single Sat-Agent source before requesting any new diagnosis-method experiment.
allowed_zero_fit_actions: Inventory the frozen 31 objects, 93 scenario rows and 145 effects by subsystem, object instance, component archetype, system level, observable quantity, physical validity, identifiability and usable diagnosis task.
Record injected Sat-Agent source, archive or revision, environment, generator, schema, configuration and input hashes without importing Sat-Agent Python objects into AstroGraph.
Inspect public telemetry schemas, channel dictionaries, units, sampling metadata and provenance while keeping hidden-acceptance truth inaccessible to AstroGraph runtime code.
Build declarative SourceAdapter, ChannelMap, SemanticTelemetryFrame and archetype-specific feature-contract schemas with one common truth-blind evidence-token output contract.
Implement non-fitting schema, unit-conversion, field-renaming, sampling-rate, channel-order, missing-data, source-hash, truth-isolation and answer-proxy leakage tests.
Use deterministic TEST_ONLY fixtures or smoke cases that are permanently disqualified from training, calibration, validation, acceptance and model selection.
Document gaps and return BLOCKED when Sat-Agent lacks the observation, physical activation or component coverage required by a frozen task.
timer_approval_required_before: Using labels, simulator truth or outcome metrics to select features, architectures, experts, gates, thresholds, regularization or conformal rules
Training, pretraining, fitting or calibrating any anomaly detector, encoder, mechanism classifier, open-set model, localizer, reasoner or dynamic gate
Creating or reserving development, calibration or technical-validation seeds for a diagnosis-method study
Generating a campaign whose purpose is separability measurement, model comparison, threshold selection or candidate evaluation
Changing any frozen G1.1 artifact, the formal 31/93/145 scope, fault classes, target granularity, thresholds, denominators or UNKNOWN/OOD policy
Generating formal open-set cases or accessing hidden-acceptance truth
Binding a production artifact, creating a technical-validation seed or starting Stage B

future_approval_ladder.stage_s1: A separate finite development/calibration-only request must freeze every task-head model count, archetype feature contract, dimensions, regularization, gating rule, within-source grouped split, new seeds, resource budget and candidate budget before fit. It does not authorize technical validation.
future_approval_ladder.stage_b: Only after Stage S1 readiness evidence is independently reviewed may a separate request propose one exact production path and a genuinely untouched technical-validation seed.

prohibited_claims: Cross-source, cross-simulator, external-domain or real-spacecraft generalization
In-orbit validity, flight qualification or safety certification
Model, method-readiness, P-018, T-310, T-311, G2, G3 or G4 PASS
claim_boundary: Project-owner-authorized Sat-Agent-only zero-fit engineering scope. source_count=1. No model fitting, label-driven selection, development/calibration/validation seed, formal open set, hidden truth access, production candidate, Stage B or cross-source/real-spacecraft claim is authorized.
